# Pull Request Title

Please use a concise and descriptive title, ideally prefixed with the type of change:

- [Feature] New functionality
- [Fix] Bug fix
- [Refactor] Refactor code
- [Docs] Documentation update
- [Chore] Maintenance tasks

---

## Description

Provide a detailed description of the changes introduced by this PR. Include the motivation, context, and any relevant background information.

Fixes/ Closes # (issue number if applicable)

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix 🐛
- [ ] New feature ✨
- [ ] Refactor ♻️
- [ ] Documentation 📖
- [ ] Chore / Maintenance 🔧
- [ ] Other (please describe):

---

## Related Issues / Links

- Link to related issue(s)  
- Link to relevant discussion, design doc, or reference

---

## Checklist

- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have tested the changes locally
- [ ] All automated tests pass
- [ ] I have added or updated documentation if needed
- [ ] I have linked related issues
- [ ] I have added screenshots, gifs, or videos if applicable

---

## Testing Notes

Explain how this PR was tested:

- Steps to reproduce
- Test environment
- Any edge cases checked

---

## Screenshots / Demo

Provide visual evidence of changes (optional):

- Before / After screenshots
- Video demonstrations
- GIFs

---

## Code Quality / Standards

- [ ] Follows project coding standards
- [ ] Proper linting and formatting applied
- [ ] No console logs or debug code left
- [ ] Meaningful variable and function names used
- [ ] No breaking changes to existing functionality

---

## Additional Notes

Add any additional context, concerns, or instructions for reviewers.  
Mention if any follow-up work is required.
